cues.text: You, Junpei, Yukari, Fuuka and Aigis come into the dorm's command room, where Mitsuru and Akihiko stand waiting.
Between Mitsuru and Akihiko sits Koromaru, the white dog, a metal collar fitted around his neck. You all walk over to him.
Fuuka gets up from beside Koromaru and turns to face the others.
